name: Torrance
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Torrance?
answer_short: A street-legal LSV can drive on Torrance streets posted 35 mph or less (CVC 21260). A plain golf cart is limited to streets posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district (CVC 21716) and may only cross Pacific Coast Highway. Freeways and the Strand are off limits. Posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Pacific Coast Highway in Torrance?
faq.a: No. PCH is a state highway posted over 25 mph, so a plain golf cart may only cross it at intersections. A street-legal LSV may use stretches posted 35 mph or less.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on the Strand?
faq.a: No. The Strand in Manhattan Beach and Hermosa Beach is a beach walkway closed to motor vehicles under each city's code, so it isn't drawn on the map.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on PCH in Torrance?
faq.a: Only west of Palos Verdes Boulevard, where Torrance's code posts PCH at 35 mph. East of there it's posted 40-45 mph.
